title: Unit Event — Popping in My Heart!

meta.Outline: Emu takes part in a discussion with her brothers regarding future operations of the park. However, each idea she puts forth comes up against issues of feasibility, leaving her determined to educate herself. That's when she gets the news of an opportunity to visit Mr. Riley's park...

rows.Line: Otori Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Goood mooorning!!
It's gonna be another fun and wonderhoy day♪

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Good morning, Emu.
Oh, Keisuke, I didn't realize you were already up.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, I have a meeting first thing this morning.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Sis, guess what?!
I just heard this from Keisuke when I was upstairs...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: He said that the night shows have gotten really popular, and lots and lots of visitors are coming to see them now!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Oh, is that true?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Yes, it is.
We're on pace to see a 112% increase over last month.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Really...?!
That show's more popular than I realized.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: It certainly is. Our ambassadorial shows have also begun to have a positive impact on the park.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe♪ That makes me so happy!!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
*Yawn*
What's with all the shouting? Can't you see it's still morning...?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Good morning, Shosuke.
You seem awfully sleepy.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Keisuke and I had a lot to discuss last night.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: A lot as in...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Mostly regarding how to maintain our attendance figures. Ideally, the night show will be able to hold its current popularity while we execute our next plan.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Yes, exactly.
And we'd like you to join us for a discussion tonight, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me? Really?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, we need someone who sees things from a different perspective. I hope you'll be willing to help.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: (They're so optimistic about the park's future. Just like when we were little.)

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: (I couldn't be happier for them.)
That night

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Captain...!
I've brought you some of my ideas, Sir!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Who was that directed at exactly?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Ah, wonderful. I shall take a look, Private Emu.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: You're going along with this?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you, Sir! I even put together a notebook of ideas for you, Shosuke!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I call it, “Operation More and More Visitors!”

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Straight to the point, huh?
Alright, let's have a look... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: “Night shows in the morning and afternoon”...?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Hold on. You can't call it a “night show” if it happens during the day!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, those shows are gonna be different from the “night show”!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The morning and afternoon shows will be about what happens before the story from the night show! Wouldn't that make the night show more fun?!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
A prequel for the night show, huh?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: That's something our core visitors would really enjoy. We'll take it into consideration.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, my next idea has to do with how to make the night show more fun while you're riding the Ferris wheel...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, that's everything!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
So many ideas...
Where did you find the time to come up with all of these?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Like when? After waking up, on my way to school, during class, on my way home and before I go to bed...?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Okay, okay, we get it!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: However, we'll have a steep hill to climb if we were to try and implement all these ideas...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: You've definitely come up with some excellent ideas, and they'll surely help us attract more visitors by putting them into practice...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
But reality isn't so kind.
We don't have the budget or manpower to pull this off.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
R-Right...!
Sorry, I didn't really think about any of that...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: And that's perfectly fine. It's also why we're having this discussion now.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Let's start with your morning and afternoon shows since it seemed like your most promising idea.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! So um... Well...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: We don't have a big enough cast to make it happen. We're already shorthanded as it is in terms of cast members compared to similar parks.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, is that true?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Unfortunately, ours is about two-thirds the size of others.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I didn't know that...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, I really don't know much about the other parks...)

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Partnering with Riley Entertainment will mean we'll need a bigger cast. Should we start putting out “help wanted” ads?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: No, we'll need to be more tactful about this. Any new cast members we hire will need to be trained, which is a burden the veteran cast members will have to carry.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We may need to rethink how we train new hires. Can you try discussing this with HR, Shosuke...?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I'm on it. The veteran cast members, show performers and creative staff should find solace in knowing that their lives aren't about to be turned on their heads.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Precisely. In theory, we should have an easier time gathering more cast members in the long run, and putting on more entertaining shows.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry. Be right back.
I need to take this.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Sure thing. Still, I'll be up to my neck in meetings with HR tomorrow. I'll just have to let them know first thing in the morning...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (That was so cool...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (They have to know so much about the other parks on top of our own. That's probably why they always “know” what decisions to make.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (While I...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Oh, I know...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Um, Shosuke!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Hm? What is it?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I want to learn more about running a business!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You guys have to think really hard about money, everyone who works at the park and lots of other stuff, right...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: If I learned more about what goes on each day, I could...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: But that's not really your department, is it, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Running a company like ours is indeed no small task, and with regards to where you fit into that...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm getting a call.
Sorry, I'll also be right back.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: But that's not really your department, is it, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Was he trying to say that I'm not really cut out for the business side of things...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But if I don't do something...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I'll just be stuck relying on everyone else.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I couldn't do anything without them when I was just claiming to want to protect the Wonder Stage and Phoenix Wonderland...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Yeah...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I don't care if I'm not cut out for it. I'm gonna try my best to learn more!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I wanna “know” how to make the right decisions too!)

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Emu? Hello?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Eep! Y-You're back from your calls?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: You didn't hear any of that just now, huh? I'll say it once more, so listen carefully.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: How does visiting the United States sound...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What...?!
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As in the United States of America?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! Because we're partnering with his company, Mr. Riley said, “You should come learn more about our park and characters by seeing them for yourselves.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That's very kind of him.
We'll get to visit one of the most famous theme parks in the world.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: B-But why us...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: About that♪ He also said, “I'm sure you'll be able to draw quite a bit from it as ambassadors trying to come up with new ideas for shows.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I was even told that Mr. Riley really, really likes the shows we do!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He does...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah... The time has come... At long last...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
My friends!
The world shall bear witness to the magnificent spectacle that is Wonderlands×Showtime!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah hah!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehehe. I'm excited as well...
Since we're going abroad, we'll be able to do some things that aren't allowed in Japan...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hey, no funny business.
Ugh... I want to have fun on this trip, you guys. Not feel this much anxiety...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Anyway, we'll need to start packing!
Make sure not to forget anything!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Yay!
We're all going together!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Alright, I'm gonna have Mr. Riley teach me everything about running a business! I can try and see what makes his park different from ours too!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(I want to “know” what to do!
Just like how Tsukasa and the others were able to fill Phoenix Wonderland with so many smiles!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll be going for a little bit, but I won't be gone long...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So I'll see you later!
se_event_nikkori_2022_001
Airport
se_event_nikkori_2022_002

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We're here!!
We're in America, you guys!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That was an exciting flight too!
An interesting start to our trip.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Exciting?
Don't you mean turbulent?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The way it went up, down, side to side, shakey-shake-GATHUNK was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, it wasn't!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ugh... How did things get off to such a rocky start...? Tsukasa had to go home to get a change of clothes and you even tried to bring Robo-Nene along, Rui...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Because I was hoping to try out the new translator function that I installed.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: There's no way we would've gotten past security!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh?
Where'd Tsukasa go?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What? Did he get lost already?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, he's striking a pose while basking in the sunlight by that window over there...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Geez, I'll just act like I don't know him...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: At last... My first step out into the world!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not even I was expecting to set out abroad so soon... My formidable talent knows no bounds!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: O brave new world...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasaaa!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huh?!
Why all the commotion, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene said, “Something terrible's gonna happen if we let Tsukasa stay lost and run around like this!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I wasn't lost! I was right here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll rejoin the group once I've taken a picture of the airport and send it over to Saki...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Tsukasaaaaa!!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What the?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hi, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Emu! Good evening♪
Wait, why's the sun still out...?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh, they're probably in a different time zone! Pretty surreal, huh?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah♪ Really surreal!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What are you all...?
Oh, that's right. We told you that we'd be taking a trip abroad.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yup☆ That's why we all decided to come and have a look♪>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Settle down, everyone. They're here to visit a park on business so we can't be too much of a bother to them.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Oh? Based on that look on your face, I'm guessing you want to see this park just as much as the rest of us.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Guilty as charged... I won't lie. It's not every day that you get to see something like this.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<I can't wait to see Mr. Riley's park.
What do you think it's like?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Whoa, hold your horses!
Don't come out all at once!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke's Voice
rows.Line:
Our papers are all in order.
Let's start making our way over.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Drats!
I-It's Emu's brother.
Hide! Hurry!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Okay!
But promise to show us around later, alright♪>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We will! Once we find a place that isn't too crowded, we'll let you guys know☆

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Hm? Hey, we're going.
You'll get left behind if you keep dragging your feet like that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: B-B-Be right there!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, everyone, let's go!
Riley Dream Park

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wooow...!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Incredible...! It's like we just stepped through a gate into a completely different world!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, isn't that the castle from “The Little Kingdom”?! I don't believe it! It's like it's straight out of the movie...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And that looks like the “Jungle Music” area. It seems to be keeping faith with the original story.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
This is so cool...!!
Everything here's so wonderhoy...!!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Please don't make me remind you that we're here on business...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Now then...
Mr. Riley said he'd be waiting for us by the entrance...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line:
Ah, there you are!
Welcome to the United States!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Mr. Riley!
It's wonderful to see you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hello, Mr. Riley!
Thank you for inviting us here today!

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: You're all in the business of making people smile, so I'm sure this park will be a great source of inspiration.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: As such, I'd like you to absorb as much as you can from here while enjoying it like anyone else.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we plan to do just that today!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Right!
I promise to learn as much as I can!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh? That's very rare coming from you, Emu, but also very noble!

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: From here, we'll be splitting into separate groups...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Keisuke, Shosuke, you'll be coming with me to headquarters. Emu, I'd like you and your friends to go around and enjoy the park for the rest of the day.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Is something wrong, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I, uh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I was really hoping to ask you some questions, Mr. Riley...! And maybe even see what your meeting with Keisuke and Shosuke's like...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line:
I see. Why don't we do this instead?
I'll meet you by the “Smiley” area at dusk around 6:00 pm. We should have time to talk then.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
...!
Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Thank you for being so accommodating, Mr. Riley. I know you're very busy...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line:
Nonsense.
There's actually something I've been meaning to show Emu and her friends.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Show us...?

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line:
Hehe. That'll have to wait until later.
Remember, 6:00 pm by the “Smiley” area!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Tsukasa
rows.Line: We'll be there!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Anyway, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Try not to go too crazy, alright?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness!
I'm actually gonna get a chance to talk to Mr. Riley!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Um, Emu...
What is it that you want to ask Mr. Riley?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me? Well... I wanna ask him about how he built this park and stuff...!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see. I'd like to know as well.
Let's make sure to meet him at 6:00 pm sharp!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But until then, let's start making our way around the park. Where to start... Actually, do I even need to ask?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Nope.
I think we all know the answer to that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I believe so!
To the show stage!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!!
Riley Dream Park

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Alright, I'm gonna learn as much as I can today! In the name of all that's wonderhoy!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Also, based on what Keisuke and Shosuke told me, I know about how much it costs to run each area with our current cast...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (First, I'll need to see what separates our park from Mr. Riley's!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... The show stage is supposed to be somewhere around here...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm still amazed at how this area's been designed. It's like we're in a real medieval castle town...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This being the area for “The Little Kingdom”, they must've gone through quite a bit of trouble to recreate the movie's medieval fantasy setting.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Riley Dream Park's designed to let its visitors experience in real life what they see in Riley Entertainment's feature films.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nowadays, parks like these are fairly commonplace, but this park remains a cut above the rest of them.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And seeing how each area is based on a different story's so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, speaking of which...!
Mr. Riley and my brothers are gone, so they can come out now, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The coast is clear, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line: <Okay!!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Ask and you shall receive!
Here's Miku☆>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I wanna do that too♪ Here's Rin♪>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh, me too! Here's Len♪>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Look at that.
Like three peas in a pod.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Hahaha!
Or more like a sardine can!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Thank you for remembering, Emu.
Are you all about to head over to see a show?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup!
We're gonna go catch “The Little Kingdom”!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It'll probably be dark inside the theatre, so we may want to sit somewhere towards the back. That way, you and the others should also be able to see the show, Miku.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<We really appreciate it.
All of you, please make sure to behave.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Okay!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <We will☆>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe. You sounded like a school teacher just now, KAITO.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Huh?
Haha. I guess I did, huh?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Aha, there it is!
That looks like the show stage!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, it's showtime!
Everyone ready?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yeah☆>
“The Little Kingdom” Stage

rows.Speaker: King
rows.Line: 『Come on, stab me in the heart!』

rows.Speaker: Prince
rows.Line: 『Dad...Please don't make me do this!』
se_event_nikkori_2022_005

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Whoa!!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(How'd they pull that off?!
The wall run they did was amazing too... This might be better than the movie!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Ah, I see. It's a fairly simple wire stunt, but they've polished quite a bit. I almost thought they actually flew there for a second...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However, what's most staggering is...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Their sheer acting ability...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'd seen videos of performances from abroad, but seeing one in real life is something else entirely...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (From the way they project their voices to even the subtlest actions... It's pure perfection. This must be the true definition of “being in character”.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I can't look away. I feel compelled to keep watching...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So this is a world-class cast...

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Riley Dream Park

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, Emu... Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh?
What?! Is it over?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, are you back from whatever trance you were in? I mean, I get how you feel. It was a pretty amazing show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Captivating and compelling to say the least.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
It was extra exciting and super spectacular!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Wait, no...! I'm here to learn, not play around!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I think I counted twenty cast members, and the theatre had a capacity of...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Tsukasa.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Yes, KAITO...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Is everything okay?
You seemed concerned there for a second.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, there is something on my mind...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <May I ask what?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It's about...
...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I wouldn't worry too much, Tsukasa.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <For your dream's sake, I say just take it one step at a time.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh. Saw right through me, did you? Nicely done.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But you're right. After all, I'm a future star...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Be it little by little, I'll be making progress toward my ultimate goal!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That was a spectacular show!

rows.Line: Hm? Where's this coming from?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: For as long as I can remember, I kept saying that I'm going to make the Wonder Stage and Phoenix Wonderland “a place that makes everyone smile”.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I didn't actually know what to do until you guys came along...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You came up with the idea of us doing a night show, didn't you...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No!
That was just something that was floating around in my head. You're the one who made it a reality, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
And it's not just you.
Nene made everyone smile with her singing.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa used his sparkly powers to convince the other cast members to help us, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: While I... I just had my head in the clouds...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I couldn't help even when it came to trying to convince my own brothers...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's why I've been trying really hard to learn how you guys, including Mr. Riley, are able to make everyone's dreams come true.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So it's true that I had a lot on my mind, and I'm sorry for making you guys worry so much...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I agree that being able to make everyone's dreams come true is very important...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But, Emu, you...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: That settles that! Thank you for waiting!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line:
Hm? Is something the matter?
It's like a somber mood's come over all of you...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, well... We were discussing something and...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
W-We'll be fine!
We can discuss this later!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Right...!
We'll hammer this out when we have more time.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line:
Are you sure?
Well, if you say so...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Anyway, I had you all meet me here today because of what I've been meaning to show you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Show us?

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Yes, it's this...
Riley Dream Park
“Smiley” area

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This place...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It seems pretty ordinary, you know...?
The merry-go-round's about the only thing that really sort of stands out.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What is it, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That merry-go-round...
It's like something Grandpa made!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Your grandfather?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
It's so warm and comfy...
And makes me wanna smile...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Just like with the Wonder Stage.
It always feels like he's right there with us.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Hehe. Good eye, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Truth be told, your grandfather, Rakunosuke, and I worked together on “Smiley”, the very movie that this area is based off of.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: The first time we met must've been twenty years ago...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: I originally aspired to become an actor, but that didn't end up working out...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: However, I still wanted to be involved in the entertainment industry, so I joined a film production company.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: I spent years and years working my way up the ladder, and finally received a chance to produce my very first film.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: I was looking forward to making something that could bring smiles and joy to everyone...

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line:
Why...?
It always turns out so plain...

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: We had the budget, stayed on schedule and hired an excellent staff. On paper, nothing could've gone wrong...

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line:
And yet...
We have to start over from scratch.

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line:
No...!
Our deadline's right around the corner, but it's still not good enough...!

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line:
What am I supposed to do...?
We had a massive budget, but having to redo everything's already put us over...

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: I just wanted to produce a movie with the same sort of wonderment that I saw growing up... Why can't I just do that...?

rows.Speaker: Film Industry Friend
rows.Line:
Hello, Jean.
Your current project seems to be giving you quite a bit of trouble.

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line:
Oh, it's you...
I heard that you've been doing very well for yourself as a director.

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line:
While I'm up a creek...
I had the perfect plan for producing this movie, but it's all gone to waste.

rows.Speaker: Film Industry Friend
rows.Line:
I see...
What if you hired a consultant?

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: A consultant?

rows.Speaker: Film Industry Friend
rows.Line: Yes, everyone's been talking about this genius who gives people just the advice they need.

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: I see... Can you tell me more about this person?

rows.Speaker: Film Industry Friend
rows.Line: Not much more than him being an elderly Japanese man. Apparently, he gives out the perfect advice if he enjoys what he sees.

rows.Speaker: Film Industry Friend
rows.Line: A friend of mine should be able to get a hold of him... What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: An elderly Japanese man...?

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: (I can't say that I have high expectations, but it's better than doing nothing at this point...)

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line:
Alright...
Mind setting us up?

rows.Speaker: Film Industry Friend
rows.Line: Great. I'll get right on it!
One week later

Hello there!
Thank you for asking to see me!

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: No, I should be the one thanking you. My name is Jean Riley... And you are...?

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Nice to meet you, Jean! I'm Rakunosuke!

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: But enough of that! Let's see this movie of yours! I can't wait to have a look at what you have for me!

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: Y-Yes, of course...

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: (He seems awfully childish for someone his age.)

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: (Is this really the consultant he was talking about...?)

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: If you don't mind, I'd like to hear what you thought about it.

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line:
What do you think needs work?
Suggestions that keep us within budget and on schedule would be ideal.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Well... If I'm going to be honest...

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: This movie... It requires more wonderment!

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Is this all your imagination can muster, Jean?! There must be more dreams and ideas in that head of yours!

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: Um... What do you mean by that exactly...?

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: For example, take the opening!

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: The place where the main character, Smiley, lives is supposed to be an “island paradise” that's full of dreams and smiles, right?

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: That means you should present it as such! More glitz! More glam! More fun! More excitement! Am I wrong?!

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, I see...
But...

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Again, this needs more and more wonderment!

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: I mean, are you satisfied with the island's denizens being computer generated?! You wanted to show people in a state of pure bliss, no?

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: Yes, we originally planned on hiring extras...

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: I knew it! How about we hire a thousand?!

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line:
A... A thousand?!
But we don't have the time or resources to hire extras...

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Anything goes when you're making a masterpiece! Hah hah hah!

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line:
(Wh-What's he talking about...?!
We can't all have what we wish for!)

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: (Still, he's supposed to be some sort of genius. What if he's right? What if there is some grand plan behind all his talk...?)

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line:
Alright, Jean!
Let me hear more about your dreams!

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: Y-Yes, of course...

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Hmm... This scene needs to be spiced up a little more. What if you made a set with an actual castle?

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line:
A castle?!
You're right that I initially hoped to have a castle made of white stone... But still...

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Ah, if this is what you call a climax, then you're going to leave a sour taste in everyone's mouths...

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Jean, there must've been more that you wanted to do here! Am I wrong?

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: What's this? This looks like a list of ideas. It even mentions your island paradise crumbling apart!

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line:
What a spectacular idea!
This is what you should be doing instead!

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: And the ending needs to be full of glee and joy! By doing so, you'll have a wonderful...

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: No... I've had enough...!

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: You've been going on and on about wonderment and dreams, but we're trying to run a business here! We have a schedule and budget to think about!

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: Yes, I want to make all these things happen! I want the world to see all of my ideas come to life!

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: But reality just isn't that kind!

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line:
You have your head in the clouds...
You call yourself an adult...?

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Yes, I'm very much an adult.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: And my family does often call me childish.

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: If you understand that, then...

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Is it wrong for us to have dreams?

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: This is what I tell people.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Only those who dream big can give others a sense of wonderment.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: So let's start by dreaming big again, Jean.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Yes, reality's a harsh mistress, and she'll be waiting for you to wake up from your dream.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: But believing in your dreams and feeling that sense of wonderment will help keep that at bay. At least, that's what I think.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: So how about it? Feel like dreaming big, together?

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: Dreaming big, together...?

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: To be fair, I've been doing this a lot longer than you have, so I'm used to dealing with reality's cruel tricks.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: But I'll be more than willing to help with schedule changes and such, so feel free to ask me for anything.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Despite how I look, I have some friends in high places.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line:
So let's just start with your dream.
Worry about the consequences later.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line:
What do you say, Jean?
Can you show me what your dreams are made of?

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: And when we do have to come back down to Earth, we can work through that together.

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: Rakunosuke...

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: (My dreams...)

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: (He's right about me placing reality above my aspirations. I'd nearly forgotten all about them.)

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: (No wonder things weren't going well...)

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: Thank you, Rakunosuke...

rows.Speaker: Young Riley
rows.Line: You're right. It's high time I started dreaming again.
Riley Dream Park
“Smiley” area

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Grandpa really told you that, Mr. Riley...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe.
It certainly sounds like something he would've done, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Dreaming big together, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Such profound words...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Rakunosuke always puts dreams and imagination above all else...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: He was there to show me how to dream again after losing my way.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: And I'm standing here today because I had the experience of making that movie with him.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: “Only those who dream big can give others a sense of wonderment.”

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: I had you all come here today because he imparted that invaluable piece of knowledge to me.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Only those who dream big...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Hm? Is something the matter, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I understand what Grandpa was trying to tell you, and what you're trying to tell us right now...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But Grandpa...
I think he told you what he did because you did almost forget what it means to dream, Mr. Riley...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: All I do is dream...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: When you spoke to Grandpa that time, Mr. Riley, you still made sure to think about the consequences of your actions.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But I'm not like that...
I always talk about doing all these different things, but have no way of actually making them happen by myself...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know that it's important to keep dreaming, but I think I have to learn to see reality for what it is!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I want to “know” how to make the right decisions like everyone else...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line:
I see...
You believe those who like to dream need to learn to stay grounded in reality?

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: You may be right...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: One must at least be willing to acknowledge that their actions have consequences if they wish to make their dreams come true.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Because just seeing dreams won't bring them to life.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: It may be necessary to gauge what you yourself can do as well as what you'll need to do the morning forward before trying to make a dream come true.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I was afraid you'd say that...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: However, I also believe that you have nothing to worry about...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: As long as you have that spark, the desire to “make dreams come true”, I think you'll begin growing naturally little by little.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: All the while blossoming into a beautiful lady.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Which is why I believe you and your friends should remain focused on what you can do right now... Putting on shows.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What we can do right now...?

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Yes, precisely.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: But you will also be faced with setbacks along the way. At times, just keeping the torch to your dream lit will be a challenge...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: If that does ever happen, my hope is that you won't forget about your “ability to dream”.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Our “ability to dream”?

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Sadly, that ability wanes as we age...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Our own limits become ever clearer over the course of our lives, which causes us to place what's “possible” or “realistic” over our imaginations.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: I experienced that firsthand.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Dreaming as you do is much more difficult than I think you realize, Emu...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It is...?

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Yes, very.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Also, you've been able to accomplish quite a bit because of your sheer “ability to dream” from what I understand.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? But I haven't...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Don't say that!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Eep?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu, listen!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Your “ability to dream” is an absolutely essential part of Wonderlands×Showtime!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
H-He's right...!
We've been able to do what we have because you never stop dreaming.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If anything, we wouldn't be here right now if it weren't for big dreamer, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Even when it was all run down, weren't you the one who wanted to bring smiles and laughter back to the Wonder Stage more than anybody else?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Your dream gave us a place where we could belong.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The same thing goes for the night show. Yes, you're right that Rui sort of made it all possible...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But you said that you wanted Phoenix Wonderland to be “a place that makes everyone smile”, and your wish actually came true, didn't it?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Simply put, Emu, you're the engine that drives us all. You have this remarkable ability to turn reality on its head...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Exactly! You can learn to bridge the gap between your dreams and reality one step at a time, but for now, you should be proud of what you're able to do!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah! And we'll be there every step of the way!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, we will.
After all, together, we seem to be capable of quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But where do we begin with her...?
What about how achieving flight took a monumental effort on the part of mankind?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Says the guy who knows what it's like to be flung into the air.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Why not start with how to actually achieve a goal and break it down into smaller steps?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, that might be good.
I remember her mentioning that she always manages to get through exams by cramming the night before.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I see.
That explains why she's so good at memorizing lines. It could be that she just needs to learn a more efficient method.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I never thought about that...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I didn't realize that my dream has been bringing smiles to so many people...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You guys...!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I've decided to hang on to my dreams while learning to balance them with reality!
song00006_off_f

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: If my dreams ever start getting too big, I promise to take a step back to see if it's really possible...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And if I start putting down my own ideas too much, I'll just crawl into bed and come up with more while I'm asleep...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You don't have to fall asleep to have a dream, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, uh... I hope you'll be willing to help!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! We'll be counting on you as well, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe! I'm so excited now! My heart's going all tick-tick-VROOM!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Tick-tick-vroom...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, like your heart's been kickstarted.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Looks like she's back to being her usual self.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Are you seeing this, Rakunosuke?

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: I have a good feeling that these kids are going to achieve something really special...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Unfortunately, the park will be closing for the day soon, so let's get you back to the hotel...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Keisuke and Shosuke will also be there, so why don't we continue our discussion regarding dreams and such when we're all together?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But something still puzzles me... Rakunosuke Otori was an amusement park operator. How did he find himself involved in the film industry...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, that's a good question...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: That comes from his dream of wanting “everyone around the world to smile”...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everyone around the world...?

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. From what I understand, he dabbled in all things regarding “entertainment” for that purpose.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Most people would normally stick to one path... But that was just how Rakunosuke was.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: He wanted everyone around the world to smile...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Now it makes sense. All those times he said, “I'm happy as long as everyone smiles...”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Everyone” meant everyone around the world...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe!
That's Grandpa for you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Everyone around the world, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That means he had the same dream as me!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My dream as a future star is to make everyone around the world smile!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You're right!!
That's probably why you and Grandpa are so alike!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Us? Alike?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hold on, Emu. He's like your grandpa?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I've been wondering this whole time why too, but now I understand! It has to be because they both want the same thing!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see... They carry the same dream and carry the same spirit as a result...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
If that's the case...!
It means I really am meant to be a big star!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Just because you have the same dream as him? Fat chance.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Ah, everyone, that seems to be our ride. Let's get back to the hotel.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Making everyone around the world smile...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (That would be the most amazing thing ever...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
I'm gonna do my best!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I was starting to get worried since something really seemed to be weighing on her, but I'm glad she found the answer she was looking for...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Me too! I'm really glad Emu's smiling again!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<The ability to dream...
It's a lovely thought, and it suits Emu perfectly!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Emu and the others really might be able to make everybody smile as long as they all keep dreaming☆>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You can do it, Emu! I believe in you!>
